newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PGNiG mining firm to issue PLN 50 mln CPs.
newsitem.headline: Polish PGNiG mining firm to issue PLN 50 mln CPs.

text.p: The Polish state-owned oil and gas mining and distribution company Polskie Gornictwo Naftowe i Gazownictwo (PGNiG) will soon start a 50 million zloty commercial paper programme, PGNiG deputy president said.

Andrzej Brach told a news conference that under the two-year programme, led by Societe Generale in Warsaw, PGNiG would issue paper from 30- to 182-days and their yield will be based on the Warsaw Interbank Offered Rate (WIBOR).
"The issues will be cyclical. We will try to target a broad and stable group of investors," said Slawomir Komonski, department head at Societe Generale, also present.

Brach said the issue would help diversify sources of financing for the company and lower costs. He said PGNiG's investment in network development and gas exploitation will be one billion zlotys annually during the next five years.
Brach said PGNiG planned to raise funds also through a eurobond issue but gave no details.
